title: Very Spicy Canadian Beef Paella
description: A hearty, one-pot dish filled with tender Canadian beef, spicy kick from red pepper flakes, and a hint of Korean flair from ferment-jang. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in an iron teppan pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan.
Sauté the diced onion until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion mixture to the browned beef and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water, ferment-jang, and red pepper flakes to the pan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the unsalted butter and stir until melted.
Add the Calrose rice to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
